title: Kourovka Notebook Problem 21.99
exact_target: Can every ordered pair of distinct points in a finite transitive action be joined by an element having either zero or at least two fixed points?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2608 (KOU-21.99). CC BY 4.0.

P. Müller, Problem 21.99, in E. I. Khukhro and V. D. Mazurov (eds.), \emph{The Kourovka Notebook: Unsolved Problems in Group Theory}, 21st edition, arXiv:1401.0300v48 (6 October 2026). This version records a refutation; the displayed question is the historically registered target.
